title: Menu and sidebar: Sessions and History on top, Storage in App, idle logo
covers: menu order, sidebar groups, idle main window, Hosting status
context: The menu runs Home, Sessions, History, Library, Servers, Settings. The sidebar starts with Sessions and History in one block with no heading, then Library, Hosting and App. Old runs is gone: runs live in History. Storage sits in App. With no session tab open the main window shows the Archipelia logo behind the text No session is open.
changed: screens.config.ts: top entries sessions and history, groups library, hosting and app
views/SessionTabs IdleBase: idle main window with Open Sessions, New session and Join a session

setup.label: window
setup.text: A normal window, about 1250 pixels wide or more.

setup.label: tabs
setup.text: No session tab is open, as after a fresh launch. The last note is optional and needs a hosting room.

steps: Launch with the command of this test. If the welcome tour opens, press Skip. Home opens. The old switch with Multiworld and Data is gone.
Read the left sidebar from the top. Sessions and History sit in one block with no heading above them.
Below that read the headings in order: Library (Games, Presets), Hosting (Servers, Hosting, archipelago.gg), App (General, Engine, Storage). There is no Old runs entry and no Data entry.
Press Storage. It opens inside App and the sidebar keeps its place.

Open the menu (three lines in the title bar). The first entries run Home, Sessions, History, Library, Servers, Settings, in that order. Widgets, Help and Advanced follow. Library holds Games and Presets, and both open.
Open the menu again. Profiles sits just above About.
Press Escape until the Multiworld window closes The main window reads No session is Run a session to open it here, with the buttons Open Sessions, New session and Join a sess
The official Archipelia logo sits soft and large behind the text, and the text stays readable.
Read the shortcuts at the bottom: Esc Multiworld window and Ctrl K Search. Press Esc to open the Multiworld window again.
pass: Sessions and History sit together at the top of the sidebar with no heading above them. There is no top switch and no Data entry.
The menu runs Home, Sessions, History, Library, Servers, Settings. Library holds Games and Presets.
Storage opens from App. Old runs does not exist any more.
The idle main window shows the official logo behind its text and the three buttons, with no mascot or crystal emblem.
fail: A Data switch or entry shows, or Sessions is under a heading or below Library.
A heading sits above Sessions and History, or they are split apart.
The menu order differs, or Library does not open Games and Presets.
The idle window shows a mascot or a crystal emblem, the logo covers the text, or the logo is missing.
notes: If the menu order differs from step 5, write the order you saw in your note.
Optional, with a room hosting (run the test Live room first): the title bar shows a status Hosting followed by the session name. Open it with Show the hosting room: the room opens.
The old Host settings card is gone. Where the room runs is the row Where in How players join in the session setup.
